title: Sixteen to Nineteen, Counting Down
label: ch:mw-teens-to-nineteen
canDo: I can say and write sixteen to nineteen in Marwadi, count one to twenty straight through, and say why nineteen is built on twenty rather than on nine.

payoff.summary: One to twenty run four ways, with the four new signs written against the numbers that needed them, and the subtractive nineteen named and explained.
